label: Dell Precision 3660 Tower workstation
description: Mid-tower workstation, 13th-gen Core K-series or Xeon W-3400, one 1GbE RJ45, up to 4 PCIe slots.
notes: 1GbE Intel I219-LM RJ45 standard; the Wi-Fi 6E card is an option, not a default. Wired-only unless configured otherwise - typical of workstation nodes that also serve DHCP/PXE.
